title: Testing, Assertions and Debugging
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Testing, Assertions and Debugging.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: Tests compare actual and expected behavior. assert is for developer invariants and can be disabled with NDEBUG. Debuggers help inspect state, breakpoints and execution steps.
understand.whyItMatters: Testing and debugging provide repeatable evidence and help prevent regressions.
understand.explain: Test normal, boundary and failure cases. Reproduce defects, inspect state, narrow, fix, and add a regression test. Validate external input normally.
